query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_memories (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  organization_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  open_id VARCHAR(255),
  fact TEXT NOT NULL,
  rationale TEXT,
  category ENUM('formulation_insight', 'material_property', 'process_parameter', 'trial_learning', 'supplier_intelligence', 'compliance_rule', 'troubleshooting', 'cost_optimization', 'quality_insight') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'formulation_insight',
  confidence DECIMAL(3,2) DEFAULT 0.80,
  citations JSON,
  tags JSON,
  source_hash VARCHAR(64),
  verified_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  is_valid BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX idx_org_category (organization_id, category),
  INDEX idx_valid (is_valid),
  FULLTEXT INDEX ft_fact (fact)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS memory_verification_logs (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  memory_id INT NOT NULL,
  verified_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  verification_result ENUM('valid', 'invalid', 'updated', 'uncertain') NOT NULL,
  old_confidence DECIMAL(3,2),
  new_confidence DECIMAL(3,2),
  verification_notes TEXT,
  FOREIGN KEY (memory_id) REFERENCES agent_memories(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS memory_usage_logs (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  memory_id INT NOT NULL,
  used_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  use_case VARCHAR(100),
  was_helpful BOOLEAN,
  FOREIGN KEY (memory_id) REFERENCES agent_memories(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
